# NKK Education Hub

> Comprehensive portal providing high-quality revision notes, past papers, and interactive learning tools for IB, A-Level, IGCSE, SAT, AP, and Common Core programs.

## Core Pages
General overview and introductory pages of the portal.

- [About Me & Philosophy](about.html): Study resources for About Me & Philosophy
- [Reference Books](books.html): Thư viện Sách Tham Khảo Toán & Hóa học Quốc Tế (IB, A-Level, AP, IGCSE, SAT)
- [AP Chemistry Prep](chem/sat-ap.html): Chương Trình Luyện Thi Hóa Học Advanced Placement (College Board)
- [NKK-Education Hub](index.html): Premium Academic Gateways for International Mathematics & Chemistry
- [News & Updates](news.html): Latest announcements, curriculum releases, past papers updates, and study guides
- [Cập nhật hệ thống đề thi IB Chemistry & IB Mathematics 2025 (Winter Update)](posts/2026-08-09-ib-past-papers-update/index.html): Thông báo hoàn thành cập nhật bộ đề thi IB Chemistry (546 tệp) và IB Mathematics (1,099 tệp) mới nhất năm 2025 trên NKK-Education Hub.
- [IB Mathematics (AA & AI) Study Guide for International School Students in District 2](posts/2026-08-10-ib-math-guide-district-2/index.html): Comprehensive IB Mathematics AA and AI study guide for students attending international schools in Thao Dien, District 2 (BIS, ISHCMC, AIS, EIS).
- [IB Chemistry (HL & SL) Study Guide & Syllabus Breakdown for International Students in District 2](posts/2026-08-13-ib-chem-guide-district-2/index.html): IB Chemistry HL/SL study guide for international school students in Thao Dien, District 2 (BIS, ISHCMC, EIS). Access past papers and topical question banks.
- [A-Level Mathematics (CIE 9709 & Edexcel IAL) Study Guide for District 2 Students](posts/2026-08-16-alevel-math-guide-district-2/index.html): A-Level Mathematics study guide for CIE 9709 and Edexcel IAL students attending international schools in Thao Dien, District 2 (BIS, AIS).
- [A-Level Chemistry (CIE 9701 & Edexcel IAL) Study Guide for District 2 Students](posts/2026-08-19-alevel-chem-guide-district-2/index.html): A-Level Chemistry study guide for CIE 9701 and Edexcel IAL students attending international schools in Thao Dien, District 2 (BIS, AIS).
- [Official Exam Release: IB Mathematics Analysis & Approaches HL Paper 1 (May 2026)](posts/2026-08-20-ib-math-aa-hl-may-2026-paper-1/index.html): Full PDF document view of the official May 2026 IB Mathematics Analysis & Approaches HL Paper 1 examination paper for international school students.
